content: A sword must be bought for its sharp blade, not for its ornate scabbard. Value essence above external appearances. (Teaching 3)
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir's mystical realization cuts through dogma to reveal the eternal simplicity of direct inner awareness and love without pretense.
practicalInsight: Observe your habitual reactions today. Discard rigid pretense and bring sincerity and warmth into your immediate duties.
reflectionPrompt: How can I replace complex mental posturing with simple, open-hearted honesty right now?
